          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// No match found"
        }), "\n\t", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

        }), "\n\t\tr.rayClusterScaleExpectation.Delete(instance.Name, instance.Namespace)\n\t} ", _jsx(_components.span, {

          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// Error reading the object - requeue the request."
        }), "\n\t", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "r.Get"
      }), " 通过 Kubernetes client 读当前 RayCluster，存在时调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "rayClusterReconcile"
      }), "；对象已不存在时忽略 NotFound，并清掉相关扩缩容预期记录。Reconcile 不是一个永远保存完整执行位置的安装脚本：同一个资源名会因为创建、Pod 变化、定时重排等原因反复进入。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此控制器需要从最新对象重新判断“已经有哪些资源”“还缺哪些资源”。例如创建 Head 失败后，下轮仍根据资源实际存在与否重试，而不是把一次 apply 当成事务成功。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "rayClusterReconcile"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "rayClusterReconcile\n  ├─ setDefaults 与 ValidateRayCluster...\n  ├─ 处理删除与可选的 GCS Redis 清理 finalizer\n  ├─ reconcileAutoscalerServiceAccount / Role / RoleBinding\n  ├─ reconcileIngress\n  ├─ reconcileHeadService / HeadlessService / ServeService\n  ├─ reconcilePods\n  ├─ calculateStatus\n  └─ updateRayClusterStatus → 必要时重新入队\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这条顺序来自 v1.4.2 的实现。存在错误时会停止后续资源协调，但仍尝试计算和写出状态。状态变了或有错误时用较短的重排；稳定状态也有可配置的定期重排。这解释了为什么一个 Pod 就绪后，CR 的展示状态可能晚一个控制周期才变化。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "head-与-worker-数量如何维持",
      children: "Head 与 Worker 数量如何维持"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "reconcilePods"
      }), " 先按集群关联标签找 Head。正常目标是一个 Head：不存在就 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "createHeadPod"
      }), "；存在一个则检查是否需要删除不健康实例；发现多个会返回错误，而不是随便挑一个作为集群入口。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Worker 按 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "groupName"
      }), " 分别处理。先由 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "GetWorkerGroupDesiredReplicas"
      }), " 算期望 Pod 数，再列出现有 Pod，处理不健康 Pod 和明确的删除名单，最后算差额："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "diff = 期望 Worker Pod 数 - 当前计入的 Worker Pod 数\n\n大于 0：创建 diff 个 Pod\n等于 0：无需调整数量\n小于 0：根据扩缩容模式决定删除哪些 Pod\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["该版本还支持 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// Add this check to make testing easier."
        }), "\n\t\tworkerReplicas = *workerGroupSpec.MinReplicas\n\t} ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "else"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如下界 1、上界 3，用户写入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "setDefaults"
      }), " 负责让后续分支拿到所需的指针字段，不能把片段脱离初始化路径看成任意缺字段 YAML 都安全。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "workersToDelete"
      }), "。数量相同并不意味着被选中的 Pod 相同，缩容不能仅把整数减小就当成工作已安全迁移。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "pod-模板怎样变成-ray-节点",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "buildWorkerPod"
      }), " 原函数如下："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

            className: "hljs-keyword",

          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(r *RayClusterReconciler)"
          })]

          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"%s-%s\""
        }), ", instance.Name, worker.GroupName), rayv1.WorkerNode, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "true"

        }), "\n\n\t", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",

        }), "\n\theadPort := common.GetHeadPort(instance.Spec.HeadGroupSpec.RayStartParams)\n\tautoscalingEnabled := utils.IsAutoscalingEnabled(&instance.Spec)\n\tpodTemplateSpec := common.DefaultWorkerPodTemplate(ctx, instance, worker, podName, fqdnRayIP, headPort)\n\t", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "len"
        }), "(r.options.WorkerSidecarContainers) > ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), " {\n\t\tpodTemplateSpec.Spec.Containers = ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "append"
        }), "(podTemplateSpec.Spec.Containers, r.options.WorkerSidecarContainers...)\n\t}\n\tcreatorCRDType := getCreatorCRDType(instance)\n\tpod := common.BuildPod(ctx, podTemplateSpec, rayv1.WorkerNode, worker.RayStartParams, headPort, autoscalingEnabled, creatorCRDType, fqdnRayIP)\n\t", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// Set raycluster instance as the owner and controller"
        }), "\n\t", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err := controllerutil.SetControllerReference(&instance, &pod, r.Scheme); err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {

function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
}
